statistics.title: Statistics
statistics.selectOrgForStats: Select an organization to view statistics
statistics.staffingHoursDescription: Based on active contracts on the 1st of each month
statistics.requiredHoursTooltip: Staffing hours needed based on children count and their FTE requirements
statistics.availableHoursTooltip: Staffing hours provided by active employee contracts
statistics.kitaYearTooltip: A Kita year runs from August through July. The alternating shaded bands mark consecutive Kita years.
statistics.staffingBalanceTooltip: Available hours minus required hours — positive means surplus, negative means understaffed
statistics.balancePercentageTooltip: Available hours as a percentage of required hours — 100% means exactly staffed
statistics.sectionStaffingDescription: Deviation of available from required staffing hours per section. 0% means exactly staffed. Positive values (green) indicate surplus, negative values (red) indicate understaffing.
statistics.contractPropertiesDescription: Distribution of today's active children by contract property (e.g. care hours, age group, supplements). Properties drive the per-child funding rate and staffing requirement.
statistics.financialOverviewDescription: Monthly income (positive, above the axis) and expenses (negative, below) derived from contracts, funding rates, and budget items. The blue line shows the monthly balance (income minus expenses). For the running total across the Kita year, see "Cumulative Balance" below.
statistics.financialSummaryDescription: Running total of monthly balance, resetting to zero at the start of each Kita year (August)
statistics.deficitConsecutive: Currently in deficit for {count} consecutive {count, plural, one {month} other {months}}
statistics.employerCostsTooltip: Employer social security contributions (percentage from pay plan)
statistics.totalIncomeTooltip: Sum of funding income and budget income for the current month.
statistics.totalExpensesTooltip: Sum of gross salaries, employer costs, and budget expenses for the current month.
statistics.balanceTooltip: Income minus expenses for the current month. For the year-to-date view across the Kita year (August–July), see the "Cumulative Balance" chart.
statistics.fundingIncomeTooltip: Expected government funding based on children's contracts and funding rates.
statistics.grossSalaryTooltip: Sum of monthly gross salaries across all active employee contracts.
statistics.budgetIncomeTooltip: Additional income from budget items (e.g. parental fees, donations, other subsidies). Configurable under "Budget".
statistics.budgetExpensesTooltip: Non-staff expenses from budget items (e.g. rent, catering, materials). Configurable under "Budget".
statistics.occupancyDescription: Monthly breakdown of children by age group and care type
statistics.budgetDescription: Monthly income and expense grid with year navigation
statistics.fundingIncomeSubTooltip: Expected government funding based on children's contracts and funding rates
statistics.fundingActualSubTooltip: Actual amounts from uploaded government funding bills
statistics.fundingActualVsCalculatedDescription: Comparison of actual government funding bills against calculated funding amounts
statistics.fundingBillMissing: No government funding bill has been uploaded for the current month.
statistics.fundingNoDataYet: No government funding bills have been uploaded yet.
statistics.fundingCalculatedTooltip: Expected government funding based on children's contracts and funding rates
statistics.fundingRegularTooltip: Regular monthly payments from government funding bills
statistics.fundingCorrectionsTooltip: Retroactive rate adjustments from government funding bills
statistics.fundingDifferenceTooltip: Year totals include corrections. Monthly rows show regular minus calculated only.
statistics.deficitNoIssues: No discrepancies found for this period.
statistics.supplementsTooltip: Additional attributes that trigger a funding supplement (e.g. integration support, language support, extended care hours). A child can carry multiple supplements, so row totals may exceed the child count.
statistics.forecastDescription: Model what-if scenarios and see the financial and staffing impact
statistics.forecastNoResults: Configure your scenario and click Calculate to see results
statistics.forecastOptimizeDescription: Automatically find the minimum number of children to add to reach your target balance over the Kita year.
statistics.forecastOptimizeMaxPerSection: Max Children per Section per Month
statistics.forecastOptimizeResult: Result: {count} children needed to reach a cumulative balance of {balance}.
statistics.forecastOptimizeNotReached: Target balance not reachable with the current constraints (max {max} children possible).
statistics.forecastOptimizeAddedToStore: The children have been added to the Children tab. You can review and adjust them before calculating.
statistics.forecastOptimizeNoImpact: Adding children does not improve the balance. Check funding configuration and contract properties.
